mission: Thrackan Sal-Solo's installation as Governor-General of Corellia and public address.
why_now: Saxan is dead; the Corellian system has moved to succession.
opening_hook: Thrackan taking the oath of office in Coronet City's Parliament chamber.
conflict: Thrackan's ambition as he settles into the office vs. the sympathetic-to-Saxan faction's grief and skepticism.
turning_point: Thrackan delivers his first public address — explicitly naming the Alliance as Corellia's enemy.
closing_hook: Thrackan on the Parliament balcony with the Corellian flag behind him.
setting: Corellian Parliament chamber, Coronet City; high ceremonial.
sensory_details: Parliament chamber's resonance; Thrackan's swearing-in hand on Corellian ceremonial book; Gejjen visible in the first row.
emotional_trajectory: Ceremonial gravity → political consolidation → explicit antagonism.
notes: Brooks First Pinch landed through succession rather than battle.
